queries.description: Show a pie or bar chart of devices grouped by device model. Use when user asks for distribution of devices by model, pie chart of device models, how many devices of each model, or breakdown of devices by type/model.
patterns: pie chart of devices by model
bar chart of devices by model
how many devices of each model
devices are sites based on the model
distribution of devices based on model
show distribution of devices by model
queries.sql: SELECT ISNULL(m.DeviceModelName, CAST(d.DeviceModel AS NVARCHAR(50))) AS Model, COUNT(*) AS DeviceCount FROM DMN_Devices d LEFT JOIN MST_Devices_Model m ON m.ID = d.DeviceModel WHERE ISNULL(d.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND d.DeviceModel IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DeviceModel, ISNULL(m.DeviceModelName, CAST(d.DeviceModel AS NVARCHAR(50))) ORDER BY DeviceCount DESC

queries.description: Show a pie or bar chart of sites grouped by sub-sector. Use when user asks for a pie chart or bar chart based on school subsectors, sub-sector distribution, or type of school (private/public). The SubSectorName column contains values like Private School, Government School etc.
patterns: pie chart based on school subsectors
pie chart based on type of school
pie chart of type of school
plot pie chart based on school subsectors
plot pie chart based on type of school
queries.sql: SELECT ss.SectorName AS SubSector, COUNT(*) AS SiteCount FROM DMN_Stations s JOIN SubSectors ss ON s.SubSectorID = ss.Id JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id WHERE ISNULL(s.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND sec.SectorName = 'Public & Govt-School' GROUP BY ss.SectorName ORDER BY SiteCount DESC
